title: Going deeper: Build the plan together
categoryContext: Growing independence at home, school and online
stageSummary: Offer real choices, preparation and participation without handing over the adult responsibility.
pressureLine: We're doing it my way this time.
possibleWeather: Older children may hear pressure as mistrust, public judgement or loss of agency. Make the reason, choice and responsibility visible.
boundary: The adult keeps the safety and timing responsibility.
practice: agree on roles, signals and the first step
principle: Include the child in planning where participation can improve follow-through.
nextSentence: The adult keeps the safety and timing responsibility. Tell me what is getting in the way, then we can agree on roles, signals and the first step.
keyLearning: Include the child in planning where participation can improve follow-through.
